title: Robot Return to Origin
summary: Determine if a robot returns to the origin after executing a series of moves starting from the position (0, 0).
statement: Determine if a robot returns to the origin after executing a series of moves starting from the position (0, 0). The robot can move 'R'ight, 'L'eft, 'U'p, or 'D'own. Return true if the robot ends at the origin, otherwise return false.
constraints: 1 <= len(moves) <= 20,000; moves contains only L, R, U, and D.
Return true exactly when the final horizontal and vertical coordinates are both zero.
hints: Opposite moves contribute opposite signed coordinate changes.
Track horizontal and vertical displacement in one pass.
Add for R/U, subtract for L/D, then require both totals to be zero.
The order of translations does not affect their final vector sum.
editorial: The order of translations does not affect their final vector sum.

tests.explanation: The upward and downward moves cancel.
Two left moves end away from the origin.
